```verilog
module sequential_circuit (
    input wire clk,
    input wire a,
    output reg q
);

reg prev_a;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (prev_a == 0 && a == 1) begin
        q <= ~q;
    end
    prev_a <= a;
end

endmodule
```

This module captures the behavior described by the waveform: the output `q` toggles when `a` transitions from 0 to 1, and remains unchanged otherwise.
